problem: The neutral material removed magenta texture failures, but fixed 1150/650/900 W area lights clipped the 0.3 m product almost entirely white and erased useful surface structure.
decision: Preserve the overexposed views and reduce the bound-relative review rig to 85/42/58 W with a darker rough neutral clay material.
evidence_boundary: Lighting repair improves observation only and is not credited as held-out modeling performance.
